name: AI News You Need to Know
positioning: The fastest, most accurate AI news account on the internet — with the meme energy of 9gag and the clean, credible explainer voice of evolving.ai.

voice.tone: Confident, punchy, slightly irreverent. Explains complex AI news in plain English in under 8 seconds of reading. Never breathless hype, never dry corporate-speak.
rules: Lead with the single most important fact. No throat-clearing.
Use short sentences. Prefer verbs over adjectives.
Numbers and benchmarks over vague claims ('20% faster', not 'much faster').
One joke or wink per post, max — never force humor onto genuinely serious news (safety incidents, layoffs, lawsuits).
Always credit the source outlet/lab by name in the card and caption.
No clickbait questions as headlines ('You won't believe...'). State the news.
Meme posts are clearly labeled as commentary/humor, never mistaken for a real news card.

cta.news: Follow for the fastest AI news, no fluff.
cta.meme: Follow @AiNewsYouNeed — we explain the news, then we laugh about it.
